advice:
In this class, you will learn the introductory contents of data analysis, which is important in data science, through lectures and exercises.
First, we will learn about "aggregation" for understanding the characteristics of data sets for various types of data. Preceding subject "Data Science"
In addition to the simple tabulation learned in "Introduction to Su", to understand the procedure for stratified tabulation and cross tabulation, and to visualize the data set.
You will also learn about graph drawing. Learn about the correlation between the following data sets. Furthermore, it is widely used in various fields.
Learn about (linear) regression analysis.
In each case, not only lectures by classroom lectures, but also exercises to actually move hands and perform analysis will be conducted.
The mathematical explanation of the mathematical background is kept to the minimum for understanding the method, practical exercises are performed, and the concrete operation method and analysis of the tool are performed.
Try to devote time to explaining the findings that can be expected from the results.
books:

requiredKnowledge:
It is essential to take the preceding course "Introduction to Data Science" and acquire the basic operations and data literacy of Microsoft Excel.
Furthermore, it is strongly recommended to take "Statistics for Engineers" to learn the basics of statistics.
Since Microsoft Excel will be used in each class, bring a laptop PC with Microsoft Excel installed.
